title: RowAccessPolicyReference
description: Id path of a row access policy.

projectId.description: Required. The ID of the project containing this row access policy.

policyId.description: Required. The ID of the row access policy. The ID must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), or underscores (_). The maximum length is 256 characters.

datasetId.description: Required. The ID of the dataset containing this row access policy.

tableId.description: Required. The ID of the table containing this row access policy.
